parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'sonar-pro', max_tokens: 4000, temperature: 0.1, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'Search SAM.gov and federal procurement sources for new solicitations, pre-solicitations, modifications, and sources sought notices posted or modified in the last 24 hours from these agencies: Defense Health Agency (DHA), PEO DHMS / DHMSM / MHS GENESIS, Veterans Affairs health IT (EHRM, CCN Next Gen), CMS/HHS health technology, FDA/HHS, GSA health IT vehicles, ARPA-H. Keywords: health IT, electronic health record, EHR, health data, clinical informatics, medical readiness, telehealth, health interoperability, FHIR, data governance, cybersecurity health. Return a JSON array of opportunities found, each with: title, solicitation_number, agency, type (solicitation/modification/pre-sol/sources_sought), set_aside, posted_date, response_deadline, naics_code, estimated_value, url, and a 1-sentence summary. If no new opportunities are found in the last 24 hours, return an empty array []. Return ONLY valid JSON.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Search for new federal health IT procurement opportunities posted or modified in the last 24 hours. Today is ' + new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] + '.' }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', max_tokens: 2000, system: 'You are a GovCon bid/no-bid analyst for a small business focused on federal health IT, data governance, clinical informatics, and defense health. Score each opportunity on relevance (1-10) considering: alignment with DHA health IT / data governance / clinical informatics, small business eligibility, contract value under $10M, and whether the work matches our capabilities. Return a JSON array with each opportunity plus a relevance_score (1-10) and relevance_reason (1 sentence). Only include opportunities scoring 5 or above. Return ONLY valid JSON array.', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Score these opportunities for relevance:\n' + JSON.stringify($json.opportunities) }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ from: 'MMT Intel <noreply@missionmeetstech.com>', to: ['mary@missionmeetstech.com'], subject: 'SAM.gov Daily Brief — ' + $json.count + ' opportunities found', html: $json.email_html }) }}
